tools.name: get_company_financials
tools.description: Retrieve full SEC iXBRL financial statements for a company we cover, pre- and post-IPO, with derived margins, growth, leverage and return ratios per period. Interim periods carry annualized figures alongside the reported ones. Provide a symbol. Also available as a paid HTTP endpoint at /api/agent/fi

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company_financials, get_ipo_social_sentiment · Public sink: get_company_financials, get_ipo_social_sentiment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company_financials, get_ipo_social_sentiment · Public sink: get_company_financials, get_ipo_social_sentiment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
